BrowserSoftware.browser_open.title: Open Browser
BrowserSoftware.browser_open.comment: Open @{browser_type:browser} and navigate to the initial URL @{url:URL}, output the result as browser object @{web_open}

browser_type.title: Browser Type
browser_type.tip: Select browser type. Requires installation of Astron RPA plugin for web automation. Path: Settings - Plugin Installation

open_with_incognito.title: Use Incognito Mode
open_with_incognito.tip: Please set the 'Astron RPA Plugin' details in the browser to 'Enable in Incognito mode' in advance

timeout_handle_type.title: Execute After Timeout
timeout_handle_type.tip: Timeout handling method. Terminate means stop page loading. Skip means skip waiting for loading without affecting page loading

web_open.title: Browser Object
web_open.tip: Output the opened browser object. Use this web object to achieve web automation

BrowserSoftware.get_current_obj.title: Get Opened Browser Object
BrowserSoftware.get_current_obj.comment: Get the browser object of the already opened browser software @{browser_type} and output the result to @{browser_obj}

browser_type.title: Browser Type
browser_type.tip: Select the browser type where the browser object is located

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Save the obtained browser object. Use this object for web automation operations

BrowserElement.wait_element.title: Wait for Element (web)
BrowserElement.wait_element.comment: Wait for element @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} to reach @{ele_status}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing the specified web element

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: Pick the web element to wait for

wait_element.title: Wait Result
wait_element.tip: Output whether the element appears/disappears. True if appears/disappears, false otherwise

BrowserElement.element_exist.title: Element Exists (web)
BrowserElement.element_exist.comment: Check if element @{element_data} exists in browser object @{browser_obj}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing the specified web element

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: Pick the web element to wait for

element_exist.title: Element Exists/Does Not Exist
element_exist.tip: Output whether the element exists. True if exists, False if not

browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing the element to click

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: Pick the element to operate on

simulate_flag.title: Simulate Manual Click
simulate_flag.tip: Simulate manual click is to simulate human operation mode clicking. Otherwise, the automation interface of the picked element will be used for clicking

assistive_key.title: Auxiliary Key
assistive_key.tip: Keyboard function key to press when clicking

scroll_into_center.title: Scroll Element to Visual Center
scroll_into_center.tip: Select whether to scroll the element to the center of the visual area. If some web pages may have offset issues, you can disable this feature

fill_type.tip: Select the method to fill the input box

scroll_into_center.title: Scroll Element to Visual Center
scroll_into_center.tip: Select whether to scroll the element to the center of the visual area. If some web pages may have offset issues, you can disable this feature

BrowserElement.similar.title: Get Similar Elements List (web)

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: Pick two similar elements at different positions on the web page

BrowserElement.loop_similar.title: Loop Similar Elements List (web)
BrowserElement.loop_similar.comment: Loop through similar elements of @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} from @{start} to @{end}, output item to @{item}, output index to @{index}

browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing similar elements

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: Pick two similar elements at different positions on the web page

end.title: End Position
end.tip: Index starts from 0, -1 means loop to last element

index.title: Loop Item Position
index.tip: Default variable can be modified. Used as index for traversing the list

item.title: Loop Item
item.tip: Default variable can be modified. Used for traversing the list

BrowserElement.element_text.title: Get Element Text Content (web)
BrowserElement.element_text.comment: Get text content of element @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} and output to @{data_pick}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing the element to get text from

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: Select the element to get text from

data_pick.title: Output Variable
data_pick.tip: Output the obtained text content to a variable

BrowserElement.slider_hover.title: Drag Slider (web)
BrowserElement.slider_hover.comment: Drag slider @{element_slider} from @{drag_type} in @{drag_direction} direction by @{percent_value}%

BrowserElement.get_select.title: Get Select Box (web)
BrowserElement.get_select.comment: Get select box @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj}

BrowserElement.set_select.title: Operate Select Box (web)
BrowserElement.set_select.comment: Get select box @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} and select matching items through @{pattern}

BrowserElement.set_checked.title: Operate Checkbox (web)
BrowserElement.set_checked.comment: Get checkbox @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} and then @{checked_type}

attribute_name.title: Attribute Name
attribute_name.tip: Enter attribute name, e.g. id, class, data-id etc.

BrowserElement.get_table.title: Get Table Data (web)
BrowserElement.get_table.comment: Get table @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} and output result to @{table_pick}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing the web page to get table from

element_data.title: Select Table Element
element_data.tip: Pick any cell element in the web page table, no need to pick the entire table

to_excel.title: Save to Table Document
to_excel.tip: Can save directly as Excel document

excel_path.title: Table Document Path
excel_path.tip: Select the path to save the document

table_pick.title: Table Object
table_pick.tip: Output the obtained table object. Data type: dictionary

BrowserElement.data_batch.title: Data Scraping (web)
BrowserElement.data_batch.comment: Scrape @{batch_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} and output result to @{table_pick}

browser_obj.title: Browser Object
browser_obj.tip: Select the browser object containing the web page to scrape data from

multi_page.title: Whether to Scrape Multiple Pages
multi_page.tip: Select whether to scrape multiple pages. By default, only the current page is scraped

page_count.title: Scrape Page Count
page_count.tip: Enter the total number of pages to scrape. For example, to scrape 10 pages, enter 10

page_interval.title: Page Turn Interval Time (seconds)
page_interval.tip: Enter the interval time for page turning. If the interval is too short and the page doesn't load completely, you can increase the page turn interval

element_data.title: Select Page Turn Element
element_data.tip: Pick the element for page turning

to_excel.title: Save to Table Document
to_excel.tip: Can save directly as Excel document

excel_path.title: Table Document Path
excel_path.tip: Select the path to save the document

output_type.title: Output Type
output_type.tip: Select table output type. By default, output is by row

output_head.title: Whether to Output Header
output_head.tip: Select whether to output header. By default, header is output

output_filter_empty_col.title: Whether to Filter Empty Columns
output_filter_empty_col.tip: Select whether to filter empty columns in the table

is_save_to_data_table.title: Whether to Save to Data Table
is_save_to_data_table.tip: Select whether to save the data scraping results to the data table

scroll_into_center.title: Scroll Element to Visual Center
scroll_into_center.tip: Select whether to scroll the page turn button element to the center of the visual area. If some web pages may have offset issues, you can disable this feature

table_pick.title: Table Object
table_pick.tip: Output the obtained table object. Data type: dictionary

table_path.title: Table Path
table_path.tip: Output the path to the saved table

BrowserElement.create_element.title: Get Element Object (web)
BrowserElement.create_element.comment: Get element object in browser object @{browser_obj} based on @{locate_type} and output result to @{element_obj}

locate_value.tip: Enter the corresponding Xpath / CSS selector / Text content based on the locate method

return_type.title: Return Value Type
return_type.tip: Select whether to return a single element object or a list of element objects

element_obj.title: Element Object
element_obj.tip: Output element object. Result is a single object or list

BrowserElement.get_relative_element.title: Get Related Element (web)
BrowserElement.get_relative_element.comment: Get @{relative_type} related to @{element_data} in browser object @{browser_obj} and output result to @{element_obj}

element_data.title: Select Element
element_data.tip: The anchor element can only be a single element object, not a list

relative_type.tip: Select related type, e.g. sibling elements, parent element, child elements etc.

child_element_type.title: Child Element Type

child_element_xpath.tip: Enter the xpath of child element. Only gets a single element

child_element_index.tip: Enter child element position. For example, 0 means the first child element

sibling_element_type.title: Sibling Element Type
sibling_element_type.tip: Select the type of sibling element to get

is_multiple.title: Whether to Return Multiple Elements
is_multiple.tip: Control whether to return a single/multiple elements when using xpath to get child elements

element_obj.title: Element Object
element_obj.tip: Output element object. Result is a single object or list
